acceptance_criteria: Missing first-run state, valid empty state, malformed JSON, invalid root shape, unreadable state, unwritable storage, failed atomic publication, reset pending, partial rebuild, and verified recovery have distinct typed outcomes.
Every non-healthy cache outcome is visible through metadata-only fleet health and the operator-facing API and console without waiting for another alert condition.
Alert delivery remains fail-open when the rebuildable cache is unavailable, and cache recovery cannot block or suppress a durably accepted alert.
Invalid or unavailable prior state is never silently reinterpreted as an ordinary empty cache by a mutation path.

A reset transaction preserves or quarantines enough prior state to report bounded retained, dropped, and unknown counts without storing keys, alert evidence, identities, paths, or raw errors in receipts.
One successful write does not clear degradation; recovery requires a fresh successful read of the published generation and an explicit reset or rebuild disposition.
Onset and verified-recovery transitions are emitted at most once per episode with registered bounded failure classes and counts only.
The compatibility loader that discards loadError is removed or narrowed so every mutation path consumes the typed load result.
The public artifact contract distinguishes deliberate deletion from unexpected failure and states the bounded duplicate-alert consequence precisely.

Focused tests cover invalid-root warning visibility, reset publication, fresh-read recovery proof, failed reads and writes, atomic failure, privacy, bounded transitions, API projection, console projection, and continued alert delivery.
blast_radius: Restart-surviving duplicate-alert suppression, alert-delivery evidence, cache reset and recovery semantics, fleet health and line API projection, operator console interpretation, privacy of diagnostics, and the public compatibility contract for fleet-alert-throttle.json.
evidence_summary: Three live reads spanning 24 seconds pinned open issue #2534 to node I_kwDOR1Sep88AAAABKQcv3w, the current title, labels, update time, URL, and exact 9,465-byte body hash while the SSH remote main remained 9a1bd7b3d3c529b276c1ad764d2c312d7f3abfc3. All decisive product and focused-test blobs are byte-identical between the prior and new pins. The public-surface document changed only in unrelated Git-guard rows, and its throttle-cache contract still says deletion is safe with at most one re-fired batch. The store returns typed loadError for a non-object root without logging, the compatibility loader discards that error, and recordAlertThrottle reloads through the compatibility loader before publishing the new entry. An isolated audit canary reproduced zero malformed-root warnings and a reset artifact containing exactly the new synthetic key, then removed all audit state. The poller reads detailed cache state once in its constructor, retains only an error code, exposes no cache state through getStatus or getStatuses, and clears the code immediately after recordAlertThrottle returns without a fresh read. The existing test explicitly calls that behavior self-healing after the first successful save. The untouched throttle-store, corrupt-store, and primary poller suites passed 152 of 152 tests again at the new exact main; the prior isolated characterization canary passed 1 of 1 after an initial out-of-tree invocation was rejected by Vitest's include rule and treated as inconclusive. A historical scan of all 39 then-open PRs found no source or focused-test overlap and 16 documentation-only collisions; publication still requires the declared fresh estate rescan. Merged PRs #673, #676, #743, and #2376 and direct main-ancestor commit b044adfefe31273cc343321de034bd5b69de9860 are partial historical work.
falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The finding is falsified if malformed-root and exceptional loads produce the same bounded transition, mutation cannot proceed from an error-discarding empty map, cache state is projected independently of alert emission, and degradation clears only after a fresh successful read of the published generation. Exact pinned-main source inspection and the isolated malformed-root/reset canary disproved those conditions. This bounded review did not recreate the issue author's strengthened second-read poller test or build a full read/write/quarantine/API/console/privacy fault matrix; the direct production call graph shows one detailed read at construction and an unconditional clear after save, while the 152 green existing tests establish current behavior rather than the missing recovery contract.
impact: Operators can see an apparently healthy fleet while restart-surviving duplicate-alert suppression is unavailable or partially reset. A later accepted alert can replace all other eligible suppression keys, permitting a bounded but unexplained re-fire batch, and the same write is treated as recovery without proving that the published cache is readable or accounting for retained and dropped coverage.
lead_verification_obligations: Re-read issue #2534 immediately before registry integration and reject this record if its state, node ID, title, labels, update time, URL, or exact body hash changed.
Reconfirm the SSH origin, local origin/main, remote main, and decisive source bytes; do not use the audit branch copy of docs/public-surface.md as a substitute for pinned main.
Land or explicitly coordinate the #2447 bounded failure taxonomy before naming throttle-cache states and transitions; preserve the fail-open delivery policy distinction from #2533.

Keep #2355 clock eligibility and suppression-episode lifecycle, #2513 rolling-log sink lifecycle, and #2514 database observation semantics outside this owner boundary except for vocabulary and projection consistency.

Add RED and GREEN tests requiring warning parity for invalid root shape, typed mutation basis, explicit reset disposition, a second detailed read before recovery, and persistent degradation when verification fails.

Add fault-injection tests for unreadable and unwritable storage, atomic publication failure, quarantine or preservation failure, partial rebuild, repeated observations, and continued durably accepted alert delivery.
Add API and console contract tests distinguishing uninitialized, valid empty, unavailable, reset pending, partially rebuilt, and verified states without waiting for another alert.

Add exact-byte privacy tests proving paths, raw errors, keys, timestamps, alert evidence, identities, targets, commands, credentials, and topology cannot enter health, transition receipts, logs, or UI.
Update docs/public-surface.md with deliberate-reset versus unexpected-failure semantics and coordinate its collision with all open documentation-touching PRs, especially taxonomy PR #2451.
Re-scan all open PR references and changed files immediately before dispatch; this audit found no current source or focused-test owner, only documentation collisions.

suggested_remediation: Replace fail-empty mutation with a typed cache-state machine and explicit reset transaction. Carry generation, observation time, bounded failure class, last successful read and write, retained or dropped counts, and suppression-coverage state; quarantine or preserve invalid prior artifacts long enough to declare a bounded disposition. Keep alert delivery fail-open, but require a fresh detailed read of the published generation before verified recovery. Project metadata-only state through fleet health, line APIs, and the console, emit one onset and one verified-recovery transition per episode, narrow the error-discarding compatibility loader, and correct the public artifact contract.
